{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
file_path = 'data/sales.csv'
df = pd.read_csv(file_path)

# Check the structure and sample of revenue
print("Sample of revenue column:", df['revenue'].head(10).tolist())

# Check for thousands separators
print("Unique values in revenue (first 10):", df['revenue'].unique()[:10])

# Check if any revenue values contain commas
has_commas = df['revenue'].str.contains(',', na=False)
print(f"Number of revenue entries with commas: {has_commas.sum()}")

# Confirm the documentation: revenue should be string with thousands separators
# Now, parse revenue: remove commas and convert to float
# But first, verify the '999999.99' outliers
outliers = df[df['revenue'] == '999999.99']
print(f"Number of 999999.99 outliers: {len(outliers)}")

# Check if they are all refunded? Or real
print("Status of outlier rows:", outliers['status'].value_counts())

# Also check if they are in 'converted' or not
print("Converted status of outlier rows:", outliers['converted'].value_counts())"}
